parameters.name: CrossAccountRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role that is created in the source account for cross-account backup.

parameters.name: CrossAccountType
parameters.description:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- SELF\_ACCOUNT: Backs up data within the current account.

- CROSS\_ACCOUNT: Backs up data across accounts.

parameters.name: CrossAccountUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the source account that is used for cross-account backup.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the ECS instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 instance IDs.
